block.vision.model.title: Vision
block.vision.model.description: Task-bound image analysis with explicit remote opt-in, structured results and uncertainty reporting.
block.vision.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.vision.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.vision.help_remote_enabled: Off by default. Sends the prepared image, task and schema to OpenAI; API usage is billed. No network call during preparation.
block.vision.help_api_key_ref: Complete reference, for example secret://workspace/openai_vision_api. Never enter the key itself.
block.vision.help_allowed_root: Only local files below this directory. Empty uses the application root. URLs and symbolic links are refused.
block.vision.help_instruction: A precise inspection question. The task input overrides it for subsequent image events; image JSON can carry its own task atomically.
block.vision.help_result_schema: Strict object schema: all properties required, additionalProperties:false. Use nullable fields for unknown values. No references or patterns.
block.vision.help_model: Pinned image-capable model. Account access is checked only when you send an image.
block.vision.help_detail: Auto balances detail; low/high are explicit provider options. Dimensions are bounded separately.
block.vision.help_max_side: Preserve aspect ratio and reduce large images. EXIF orientation is applied; metadata is removed.
block.vision.help_max_pixels: Reject excessive decoded images before conversion; no silent crop.
block.vision.help_max_bytes: Bound the source file before decoding; default 10 MiB.
block.vision.help_timeout_sec: Stop cancels local processing and closes the request. An already submitted request may still be billed. No automatic retry.
block.vision.help_max_output_tokens: Incomplete or invalid JSON produces issues only, never a partial result.
